morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整外来形容词记忆；不分析为马来语词根加本族词缀。此处采用符合马来语拼写的宽式音标，ma 读 /ma/。

word_family.gloss: 外交；外交手腕；同源借词

senses.zh_definition: 外交的；涉及国家之间正式关系、交涉或外交事务的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to diplomacy or formal relations between countries.
senses.nuances: 这是正式、常见的国际关系用语；通常修饰 hubungan、perwakilan、misi 等名词。不能仅因某活动有外国人参与就称其为 diplomatik。

senses.zh_definition: 说话或处事谨慎委婉、顾及他人感受的；有时也指措辞含蓄、不把立场说透的。
senses.en_definition: Tactful and cautious in expression, sometimes deliberately noncommittal.
senses.ms_definition: Dengan berhati-hati atau samar-samar apabila mengatakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 输入所引 Kamus Dewan 将此义标为口语义。既可赞许表达得体，也可暗示回答模糊、回避明确表态，褒贬取决于语境。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kedua-dua negara bersetuju untuk memperkukuh hubungan diplomatik melalui dialog berkala.
dual_scenarios.zh: 两国同意通过定期对话加强外交关系。
dual_scenarios.en: The two countries agreed to strengthen diplomatic relations through regular dialogue.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jawapan kau tadi diplomatik betul lah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你刚才那回答可真够委婉的。
dual_scenarios.en: That was a very diplomatic answer.
spoken_features: 形容词后的 betul 表示程度很高
lah 加强带调侃意味的评价

messages.speaker: Mei (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Jawapan kau tadi diplomatik betul lah.
messages.zh: 你刚才那回答可真够委婉的。
messages.en: That was a very diplomatic answer.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak jaga hati dia je, tapi masalah tu tetap kena bincang.
messages.ms_standard: Saya hanya mahu menjaga perasaannya, tetapi masalah itu tetap perlu dibincangkan.
messages.zh: 我只是想顾一下他的感受，但那个问题还是得谈。
messages.en: I just wanted to spare his feelings, but we still need to discuss the problem.

etymology.historical_story: Diplomatik belongs to the international vocabulary of diplomacy. Its European relatives trace back through forms such as French diplomatique and Latin diploma, a document or letter of introduction. That documentary background offers a useful bridge between its modern meanings: official relations between states, and careful language used to manage relationships between people. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=diplomatic)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diplomat“外交官”与 diplomatik 连起来：外交事务是 diplomatik，说话像外交官一样委婉也可用 diplomatik。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 人际交往中，diplomatik 常表示顾及面子、避免直接使人难堪。评价他人回答 diplomatik 时，语气可能是赞赏，也可能是轻微调侃。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合职场反馈、分歧协商和敏感话题。委婉表达仍应让对方明白关键事实；需要明确决定时，可礼貌追问具体立场。
